dialogue.content: あか　と申します。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: My name is Aka. It's nice to meet you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: はにわさんとお呼びしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I call you Haniwa-san?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日は　どんなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 学校に行けないんです
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつごろからですか？
dialogue.English: Since when has this been happening?

dialogue.content: 半年前くらいです
dialogue.English: About half a year ago.

dialogue.content: はにわさんは半年前までは登校してたのかな？
dialogue.English: So, Haniwa-san, were you attending school up until six months ago?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今はどうして学校をやすんでいるのかな？
dialogue.English: Why do you think you're not going to school now?

dialogue.content: 行くのが怖くて行けないんです
dialogue.English: I'm too scared to go.

dialogue.content: 怖いんですね
dialogue.English: So you feel scared.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 怖い所って例えばどんなことですか？
dialogue.English: What kinds of things make you feel scared, for example?

dialogue.content: 周りの目ですね
dialogue.English: The way people look at me.

dialogue.content: お友達とかですか？
dialogue.English: Like your friends?

dialogue.content: 友達はいないので、先生とか他の学生です
dialogue.English: I don't have any friends, so it's the teachers and other students.

dialogue.content: 先生と他の学生は何か　はにわさんに　嫌なこととかするのかな？
dialogue.English: Do the teachers or other students do anything unpleasant to you, Haniwa-san?

dialogue.content: 直接何かされるとかはないです
dialogue.English: They don't do anything to me directly.

dialogue.content: 怖い気持ちは　はにわさんの中で思っているんですね
dialogue.English: So the scary feelings are something you're feeling inside, Haniwa-san.

dialogue.content: かもしれません
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: 休む前は周りの目はこわくなかったのかな?
dialogue.English: Before you started staying home, were you not scared of how others looked at you?

dialogue.content: 多少は怖かったですね
dialogue.English: I was somewhat scared, yes.

dialogue.content: 怖くなる気持ちも一人で抱え込むから　つらいですね
dialogue.English: It must be tough holding onto those scary feelings all by yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今はお家で　休んでいるのですか？
dialogue.English: Are you resting at home now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きぶんはどんな感じです？
dialogue.English: How have you been feeling?

dialogue.content: 悪いです。
dialogue.English: Not good.

dialogue.content: お家でも先生とか学生いないのに　悪いのかな？
dialogue.English: Even though the teachers and students aren't at home with you, you still feel bad?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いまも怖い気持ちなのかな
dialogue.English: Are you feeling scared right now as well?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 普段のなかで　何か怖い忘れるようなことはありますか？
dialogue.English: In your daily life, is there anything that helps you forget the scary feelings?

dialogue.content: どういうことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean?

dialogue.content: 怖いという気持ちが　楽になるような事かな？たとえば　ゲームとか
dialogue.English: Something that makes the scary feeling easier to bear? For example, playing games or something.

dialogue.content: 動画を見たりとかですかね。
dialogue.English: Maybe watching videos.

dialogue.content: 動画をみるんですね。何をにてるんですか？
dialogue.English: So you watch videos. What kind of things do you watch?

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい　何を見てるんですか？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, what kind of videos do you watch?

dialogue.content: ゲームの動画とか旅行の動画とかですね。
dialogue.English: Things like gaming videos and travel videos.

dialogue.content: おもしろそうですね
dialogue.English: That sounds interesting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 動画を見てるときは　先生の事　他の学生の事は　少しはこわくないのかな
dialogue.English: When you’re watching videos, do thoughts of teachers and other students feel a little less scary?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: 周りの人とかに　怖い気持ち相談したりとかはありますか
dialogue.English: Have you ever tried talking to anyone around you about these scary feelings?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どうでしたか？
dialogue.English: How did that go?

dialogue.content: あんまり聞いてくれなかったです
dialogue.English: They didn’t really listen.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは　はにわさんもすっきりしませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must not have been very relieving for you, Haniwa-san.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 少しでも　怖いという気持ちが消えるといいのですが
dialogue.English: It would be good if that feeling of fear could fade, even just a little.

dialogue.content: そうすればいいんでしょう
dialogue.English: What should I do for that to happen?

dialogue.content: 失礼しました
dialogue.English: Excuse me.

dialogue.content: どうすればいいんでしょう　です
dialogue.English: I meant to say, 'What should I do?'

dialogue.content: 動画をみてる時は気分が少しは楽にんるのであればそこを　ためしてみるのは？
dialogue.English: If you feel a little better when you're watching videos, how about trying to build on that?

dialogue.content: 具体的にどうしたらいいんでしょうか
dialogue.English: Specifically, what should I do?

dialogue.content: はにわさんが　動画をみてたら　もしかしたら怖い気持ち段々なくなるかもよ
dialogue.English: If you keep watching videos, Haniwa-san, maybe the scary feelings will gradually fade.

dialogue.content: でもここ半年ずっとそういう生活なんですがなにも変わっているような気がしないんですよね。
dialogue.English: But I've been living like that for the past six months, and I don't feel like anything has changed.

dialogue.content: 先ほど　ゲームや旅行の動画を見てるみたですので自分の好きな動画を見てみるのはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you watch gaming and travel videos, so how about watching videos you really like?

dialogue.content: かわってないんですね
dialogue.English: So it hasn't changed.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: No, it hasn't.

dialogue.content: 気持ちが　自分の中で　すっきりするときは　どんなときなのかな？
dialogue.English: When do you feel a sense of relief inside?

dialogue.content: 怖くないと思える時でしょうか
dialogue.English: Times when you don't feel scared?

dialogue.content: スッキリするときはないですね。
dialogue.English: There aren't any times I feel relieved.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はにわさんは　怖いというお気持ちをなくせたらうれしいですか？
dialogue.English: Haniwa-san, would you be happy if you could get rid of that feeling of fear?

dialogue.content: なくせたら嬉しいです
dialogue.English: I would be happy if I could.

dialogue.content: 少しづつでも　怖い気持ちがなくなるとよいですね
dialogue.English: It would be good if that scary feeling could fade, even little by little.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 動画はお好きな感じでしたが　他にはないのですか？
dialogue.English: You seem to like videos, but is there anything else?

dialogue.content: 特に思いつかないですね。
dialogue.English: Nothing really comes to mind.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 今はほぼ楽しいことないですね。
dialogue.English: There's almost nothing I enjoy right now.

dialogue.content: 楽しいことがないんですか
dialogue.English: You don't have anything you enjoy?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: はにわさんの楽しいことって何でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What do you find fun, Haniwa-san?

dialogue.content: やはり動画を見ることかな？
dialogue.English: Is it still watching videos, perhaps?

dialogue.content: そのくらいしか思いつかないですね。
dialogue.English: That's about the only thing I can think of.

dialogue.content: それだけでも思いつくのは　すごいですね
dialogue.English: It’s great that you can think of even that.

dialogue.content: そうですかね
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: 私はおもいます　自分で考えて答えをだせてるでしょうから
dialogue.English: I think so, because you're thinking for yourself and coming up with an answer.

dialogue.content: まずは　動画を見て　少しでも気持ちが楽になるようになるとよいですね
dialogue.English: For starters, it would be good if you could watch videos and feel even a little more at ease.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: はにわさんの中で　動画を見て　新しい発見や勇気がわくかもしれませんよ
dialogue.English: By watching videos, you might find new discoveries or courage within yourself, Haniwa-san.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ちょっとでも怖い気持ちがなくなると良いですね
dialogue.English: It would be great if your fear could lessen, even just a little.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: I hope so.

dialogue.content: 今日は　お話されてみて　いかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel about talking today?

dialogue.content: 動画を見てどう変わるのかよくわからないです。
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure how watching videos is going to change anything.

dialogue.content: そろそろお時間なので　終わりにしたいと思いますまたの機会にご相談くださいね
dialogue.English: It's about time for us to finish. Please feel free to come and talk again another time.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: 少しづつ　すすんでいきましょうね。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Let's take it one step at a time. Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
